question: MA30和MA60的平均值比 MA5, MA10, 和MA20的平均值低多少？

steps.description: Locate the MA5 moving average value on the chart and read its numerical value
Locate the MA10 moving average value on the chart and read its numerical value
Locate the MA20 moving average value on the chart and read its numerical value
Locate the MA30 moving average value on the chart and read its numerical value
Locate the MA60 moving average value on the chart and read its numerical value
Calculate the average of the MA5, MA10, and MA20 values obtained from previous steps
Calculate the average of the MA30 and MA60 values obtained from previous steps
Subtract the average from step_7 from the average from step_6 to find the difference
The absolute value of the difference represents the final answer
